chat.title: Chat
chat.tipReadOnly: Read Only mode: the AI can read your note but never modify files.
chat.tipChatOnly: Chat Only mode: pure conversation, no access to your files.
chat.tipWorkspaceWrite: Workspace Write mode: the AI can read and modify files in your workspace.
chat.tipModeSelector: Use the mode selector to switch between Read Only, Chat Only and Workspace Write.
chat.tipUndo: /undo — undo all file changes from the last turn.
chat.tipSelection: Select text, then send it to Chat to ask about just that part.
chat.activeProviderDisabled: You can't send messages while the current provider is disabled. Enable it in Settings (Providers).
chat.compressedHistory: *(Earlier conversation was compressed to keep the context window manageable.)*

undo.description: Undo the last agent file changes

chat.deleteConfirm: Delete session “{title}”? Its transcript and context cannot be restored.
chat.contextUsageUnknown: Context window unknown. Set it in Chat plugin settings.
chat.undoCommand: /undo — undo all file changes from the last turn
chat.undoBlockedReadOnly: Cannot undo in Read Only mode
chat.redoBlockedReadOnly: Cannot redo in Read Only mode
chat.subagentFailed: Sub agent failed or was aborted

settings.title: Chat
settings.providerDesc: API provider used by the chat plugin.
settings.providerIdDesc: Unique id used to store the custom provider.
settings.apiKeyDesc: Stored obfuscated in the vault config file / localStorage.
settings.modelParametersDesc: Configure per-model parameters by clicking a model in the sidebar. A model only appears in the sidebar model select after being added to this list.
settings.contextWindowDesc: Model context window in tokens. Used to show the context-usage ring; leave empty to auto-detect.
settings.forbiddenPathsDesc: Simple glob patterns (one per line) for vault paths the agent must never list, read or modify. `.git`, `node_modules` and `*.apikey` are always forbidden.
settings.maxIterationsDesc: Maximum number of tool-call rounds in one agent loop.
settings.skillsDesc: SKILL.md folders auto-loaded from the directories below. Invoke one explicitly with /skill:<name> in chat, or let the model call use_skill when a task matches.

models.disabled: Provider is disabled — model list hidden. Enable it in Settings (Providers).
